main_text.p: ga Dei providentiam de paranda uxore. Domus enim (inquit Salomon) & divitiae dan-tur à parentibus: à domino aut uxor prudes.
Quintò ipsa divina providentia per ministerium angelorum in coniugijs sanciendis apparens, Tob 7.

Sextò fides servi, obedientia, pietas & oratio. Estque hoc consolatione plen[?]simum, quòd pius Abraham ac servus eius auspicem, ꝑ[?] fidemq; nuptiarum constituunt Deum, o[?] antque ut filio Isaac [?]enè prospicere dignetur, atq; fortunare matrimonii. quod tanti fecerunt, & in cons. estu Dei tam honorabile reputarunt, ut crediderint missum iri coelitùs angelum, ad omnia prosperanda co nubij futuri negocia. Quia ergo cura singulari Dei, piorum matrimonia angelo-rum ministerio (ut contrà impiorum scortationes & adulteria dæmonum consilio ac ope) geruntur: (Tob.6.7.8.) idcirco debent matrimonia piè & sanctè sanciri, atque sancita geri & haberi.

In colloquio servi & Rebeccæ considera-remus non solum pulchritudinem & virginitatem spiritualis Rebeccæ, id est, Ecclesiæ sanctæ: sed etiam charitatem & hospitalitatem, ex qua etiam discipuli Christi cognoscuntur, Ioan.13. item munera sponsalia, quibus nova sponsa[?] ornata fuit. Protulit enim servus Abrahami ornamenta aurium & mannum: quæ ornamenta usurpata à sanctis olim, ornatum commendant, luxum ad ostentationem

page.notes: The paragraph sign before "In colloquio" is not transcribed. The last line "tationem" is right-aligned and is the end of "ostentationem", which is continued from the line above without a printed hyphen. "plen.(simum" is read as plen[?]simum, a doubtful word. "o antque" is doubtful. "Isaac ene" has a doubtful word before "prospicere". "matrimonii" is read from "ma rimonii" and is doubtful. "cred:derint" is read as crederint. "angelo*rum" carries a mark at the line end that is read as a hyphen. "fpon'a" is read as sponsa with a doubtful mark. "Ioan.1ʒ" is read as Ioan.13. "ministerio(vt" and "parentibus:à" are spaced as read.
